coldLaunch.method: service start to its ready line on a fresh workspace, 5 runs; the OS file cache is warm after the build (fresh workspace, not a cold OS cache); with 5 runs p95 is the maximum

reopen.fixture: one 10 s 1280x720 H.264/AAC clip, 200 saved revisions; service start to project open over the authenticated API, 5 runs

browserPages.method: every request made by the journey's browser pages, recorded by the E2E (page.on('request')); allowed: 127.0.0.1, blob:, data:, and the browser's own built-in pages (about:, edge:, chrome:, such as its download panel), which are not network requests

serviceTree.method: Get-NetTCPConnection for the service process and every descendant, sampled during the browser E2E; UDP (DNS) is not captured, and a connection shorter than the sample gap can be missed
